subject: maths
question: A water tank has two inlet pipes (A and B) and one outlet pipe (C). Pipe A can fill the tank in 4 hours, Pipe B can fill the tank in 6 hours, and Pipe C can empty the tank in 8 hours. If all three pipes are opened for the first 3 hours and then Pipe C is closed, how much total time is required to fill the tank?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rates: A = 1/4, B = 1/6, C = −1/8

Net rate (A + B + C) = 1/4 + 1/6 − 1/8 = 7/24

Work done in first 3 hours = 3 × (7/24) = 7/8

Remaining work = 1 − 7/8 = 1/8

Now only A + B work ⇒ rate = 1/4 + 1/6 = 5/12

Time = (1/8) ÷ (5/12) = 3/10 hour

⇒ Time to complete remaining work = 3 ÷ 10 = 0.3 × 60 = 18 minutes

⇒ Total time = 3 + 30 = 3.3 hours

∴ The correct answer is 3 ho
